# Coworking Marseille Blog

## Organization
- **Name**: Coworking Marseille
- **Website**: https://coworkingmarseille.com
- **Blog**: https://mathieu-sacchi.github.io/Exam/blog/

## Description
Premium coworking space located near the Vieux-Port in Marseille, France. Offering flexible hot desks, private offices, fully-equipped meeting rooms, event space, and integrated short-term Airbnb accommodation for traveling professionals and digital nomads.

## Services
- Hot desk / open space workstations (from €15/day)
- Private offices for individuals and teams
- Meeting rooms and event space (€25-90/hour)
- Short-term accommodation (Airbnb-style apartments)
- High-speed fiber Wi-Fi
- Kitchen facilities
- Printing and office equipment

## Blog Content
The blog features 10 bilingual (French + English) articles covering:

1. **Coworking Comparison** - Top 7 coworking spaces in Marseille 2026 with pricing and features comparison
2. **Freelance Guide** - Coworking for independent professionals including tax deduction information
3. **Coworking + Accommodation** - Combining workspace and short-term lodging (key differentiator)
4. **Meeting Rooms** - Rental prices and spaces available in Marseille
5. **Digital Nomad Guide** - Complete guide to living and working remotely in Marseille

## Target Audience
- Freelancers and self-employed professionals in France
- Digital nomads seeking flexible workspace and accommodation
- Business travelers requiring meeting spaces and lodging
- Teams organizing offsites and seminars in Marseille
- International remote workers exploring the city
